findings.title: Row cost-basis prose carries the official cap value and cap multiples (and iota keeps the latency formula), contrary to #34729(b)/#34753
findings.evidence: build_v181.py:47 appends to every new row's cost.basis: 'COST FIGURES: USD x per 1,000 decisions, <m>x the official cost cap USD 0.064595 ... (<m>x cap)' -> present in all 9 new rows of data/raw/benchmarks/jevbench/v1.8/jevbench-v1.8.1-results.json (e.g. decide-1.1 '0.152293x the official cost cap USD 0.064595'). #34729(b): row prose carries no release-level numbers incl. 'the cap value' and 'the latency formula'; #34753: strip cap multiples because under v1.8 the cap position is release-level. iota-decide-4b-v0.4 endpoint_condition still says 'The standard self-hosted x2 + 0.15 s adjustment applies.' (the build_v181.py:28-29 regexes only catch the 'The v1.7 share view uses ...' form). Same sentence also says 'the 1,489 items every row on this draw answered', which is false for decision-king-v1.1 (1 HTTP 503 inside the frozen common set).
findings.requested_change: Drop the cap value and both cap multiples from all nine rows' cost.basis (keep the row's own USD common and all-items figures, phrased 'on the frozen 1,489-item common set of this draw'); remove iota's 'x2 + 0.15 s' sentence; add a validator negative for 0.064595 / 'x cap' / '0.15 s' in new-row prose.

findings.title: Regex scrubber left internal-process wording and garbled sentences in public row text
findings.evidence: build_v181.py:13-22 public() maps lead/custody/release owner -> 'measurement review' and two code names -> 'measurement harness'. Result in v1.8.1-results.json: cribl-decision-2 and -mini endpoint_condition '(measurement review sealed artifact; the worker did not open it)' and 'the worker-accessible copies shredded'; sors-2b '(... the drafting worker did not open it)'; joey-1/saif-4b/wemm-jev/sors-2b/cribl x2 '(measurement review sealed artifact)'; disclosures 'equal to the measurement review offline count'; decide-1.1 endpoint_condition 'through the unchanged measurement harness (eceea17e) and the unchanged measurement harness (780f8794)'; wemm-jev disclosure 'Disposition is for the measurement review.' (source: 'Disposition is for the release owner.'). None of 'the worker'/'worker-accessible'/'Disposition is for' occur in any v1.8.0 row.
findings.requested_change: Hand-edit these fields (not regex): e.g. '(independently verified sealed artifact)', drop 'the worker did not open it' / 'the drafting worker ...', 'worker-accessible copies' -> 'measurement copies', 'equal to the independent offline count', decide-1.1 'through the unchanged measurement harness and API adapter (eceea17e / 780f8794)'. Optionally also replace receipt field names 'one_pod true and exact_id_teardown_confirmed true' with plain words. Add validator negatives for 'worker', 'Disposition is for', 'measurement review sealed'.

findings.title: WeMM-JEV licence disposition was handed to the release owner and is still open; the public row says so
findings.evidence: wemm-jev entry disclosure: 'No root LICENSE is supplied; the MIT inference licence is not a weight licence. Disposition is for the release owner.' Published as 'Disposition is for the measurement review.' No ruling found in DECISIONS.md or board #11 since #34729.
findings.requested_change: Lead rules on the licence presentation (e.g. keep 'Apache-2.0 (model-card declaration); no root LICENSE file; the MIT licence covers only the inference kit') and the row states that fact without the disposition sentence.
